dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, I'm really sorry, but I can't make it on Friday.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, aɪm ˈriːli ˈsɑːri, bʌt aɪ ˈkænt ˈmeɪk ɪt ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! What's your excuse this time?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌts jʊr ɪkˈskjuːs ðɪs ˈtaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's not an excuse! I have a big test on Monday, so I need to study.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈnɑːt ən ɪkˈskjuːs! aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈbɪɡ ˈtɛst ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, soʊ aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈstʌdi.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK, OK. Can you come next Friday instead?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, oʊˈkeɪ. kən juː ˈkʌm ˈnɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ ɪnˈstɛd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I can. I'm really sorry!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈkæn. aɪm ˈriːli ˈsɑːri!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No problem. I'll cancel our karaoke room.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈprɑːbləm. aɪl ˈkænsəl aʊər ˌkɛriˈoʊki ˌruːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. I can't go out this week because I need a good grade.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. aɪ ˈkænt ˌɡoʊ ˈaʊt ðɪs ˈwiːk bɪˈkɔːz aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈɡʊd ˈɡreɪd.
